name: commerce
about: Shopping: products, pricing plans, carts, ratings, comparisons and prices.

Product.about: one product with its price; a short description between the tags, then a Button with ask for each thing the reader can do with it (Add to cart, Tell me more); rating is out of 5, count how many rated it. When the reader is choosing what to buy, show each option as one, side by side in Columns

Plan.about: a pricing plan, its features as a Markdown list inside

Cart.about: items and totals, from the Markdown table inside: the item, the quantity, the price

Rating.about: a real star rating out of max, never a made-up one

Compare.about: options side by side, from the Markdown table inside: the feature, then one column per option; yes and no become marks

Price.about: a price, with the old one struck through
